name: Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc
source: Nairobi Securities Exchange Plc audited group results for the year ended 31 December 2025
source_note: Kshs'000 x1000 to absolute KES. 2024 closing cash (116,748,000) does not equal the printed 2025 opening (318,806,000) - issuer inconsistency retained. The H1 2026 column is the unaudited summary statement of cash flows for the six months to 30 June 2026: net cash from operating activities 161,017 (Sh'000).

rows.label: Operating Cash Flow
rows.source: total of the operating section of the printed cash flow statement, after tax and interest, taken from the statement row labelled for net cash from operating activities

rows.label: Net Increase/(Decrease) in Cash
rows.formula: operating cash flow plus investing cash flow plus financing cash flow, cross-checked to closing cash less opening cash

rows.label: Net Change in Cash
rows.derivedCellFormula: Net Change in Cash = Operating + Investing + Financing cash flow, all three rows already stored for the same period

reconciliation_note: Opening cash plus the net movement does not equal closing cash in FY2025 (as filed, before translation and other non-cash movements); the figures are shown unchanged.
